entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3596003497911958528: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.0970 +/- 0.0318 mas (same row, RUWE 1.53): 196.19 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -62.466, 6.665 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.95 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-158 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156...78L/abstract). Mass 0.92 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-158 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018AJ....156...78L/abstract). Temperature 5503 +/- 51 K from Livingston et al. 2018, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-158 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Color
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,503 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffede1. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,503 K and log g 4.45 (u1 0.520, u2 0.221): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
